elena (sec): Noticed earlier: partner backups include KMS-wrapped blobs and an S3 access log showing a read by a stale partner role. May be due to the RBAC change last week. Need containment and rotation.
rahul (eng): Can you share the exact log entry and object key?
elena (sec): Log:
```
2026-03-20T18:12:03Z GET /partner-backups/2026-03-19/backup-20260319.tar.gz 200 "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/partner-replica" src=34.201.12.45
```
Object: s3://partner-backups/2026-03-19/backup-20260319.tar.gz.enc
carmen (infra): That bucket had cross-account read for role/partner-replica. We rolled a change to allow the partner-ingest runners last Thu; suspect policy used Resource: "arn:aws:s3:::partner-backups/*" too broadly.
mike (sre): Assume worst-case: any object in the prefix listed in that window could be downloaded. Proceed with rotation.
elena (sec): Immediate actions: revoke partner Vault tokens, rewrap KMS ciphertext to new CMK, rotate keys inside backups (DB creds, API keys), and enable detailed audit logs.
jenna (infra): Revoking tokens now: `vault token revoke -prefix partner-ingest/` -> `revoked 27 tokens`
rahul (eng): Rewrap approach: use `aws kms re-encrypt` to move ciphertext from OLDKEY -> NEWKEY. Sample:
```
aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://backup.enc --source-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/OLD --destination-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/NEW --output fileb://backup.reenc
```
I'll run a dry-run on a sample file.
carmen (infra): I'll tighten the IAM policy to restrict to the exact prefixes the partner needs. Pushing a PR now and will deploy.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-034 created and assigned to #eng-security

rahul (eng): Dry-run succeeded. Scheduling batch re-encrypt for all objects under the exposed prefix. ETA: 2h for full job, starting after CI checks.
mike (sre): Enable Vault file audit and forward to central logs. Add S3 server access logging to redwood-audit-buckets with 365d lifecycle.
jenna (infra): Vault audit already enabled but retention low; bumped to 90d and shipped to ELK. S3 logging enabled.
elena (sec): Decision: do re-encrypt immediately and deny cross-account decrypt in key policy. Later schedule CMK rotation for all backups.
rahul (eng): Agree. Re-encrypt + key policy change is fastest; create KR ticket for full CMK rotation.
carmen (infra): PR merged and deployed at 2026-03-20T19:04:12Z (commit 5c3f9a2). IAM policy no longer uses wildcard.

jenna (infra): Also revoked Vault leases for partner secrets:
```
vault lease revoke -prefix secret/partner-
```
Output: `revoked 103 leases`

rahul (eng): Full rewrap completed at 2026-03-20T19:55:01Z. Verified old-key decryption fails, new-key succeeds for samples. Created KR-2026-112 for scheduled CMK rotation.
elena (sec): I'll coordinate credential rotations with partner success and legal for notification wording. Drafting message now.
mike (sre): Add postmortem items: IAM linter for PRs touching cross-account roles and preflight checks for backup bucket policies.

elena (sec): Summary list of owners:
- jenna: Vault token/lease revocations (done)
- carmen: IAM policy tighten and deployment (done)
- rahul: KMS re-encrypt job + verification (done)
- mike: Audit log retention updates (done)
- elena: Credential rotation owner + partner comms

incident-bot: INC-2026-034 status set to mitigated by elena (sec)
elena (sec): Thanks all. Brief at 20:00 in #eng-security-briefing to walk through post-incident actions.
